        - heading "Understand Parametric Differentiation" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "Parametric differentiation finds dy/dx when x and y are both functions of a parameter. In Parametric Differentiation, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Parametric derivative: dy/dx=(dy/dt)/(dx/dt). You can learn Parametric Differentiation by trying one small example instead of long theory."
